answer: Represent attestations as a weighted graph; trust wanders along bounded k-step random walks, and voting weight follows endpoint mass, not identity count. A sybil cluster may echo claims internally, yet a sparse external cut gives it low conductance, φ(S)=cut(S,¬S)/vol(S). Conductance and min-cut transitivity bounds therefore cap the walk mass, and thus aggregate vote, it can attract without trusted links; a lotus of aliases cannot manufacture those edges.
